labs.title: HTML, CSS & JavaScript Lab
labs.description: A hands-on, project-driven lab where you build real things from scratch. Sprint 1 teaches you HTML by building a full restaurant menu page. Sprint 2 has you style that page to look like a professional website using modern CSS. Sprint 3 takes you all the way to a fully interactive Task Manager app with JavaScript and localStorage. Each sprint is a complete, standalone project — not exercises, but real products.
